definitions.gloss: very busy, hectic, having a packed schedule
definitions.explanation: Having an extremely full schedule with many tasks or obligations. More formal and emphatic than {忙|いそが}しい.

examples.japanese: {多忙|たぼう}な{日々|ひび}を{送|おく}る。
{多忙|たぼう}を{極|きわ}めていて、{休|やす}む{暇|ひま}がない。
examples.english: I'm extremely busy and have no time to rest.

examples.japanese: {多忙|たぼう}なスケジュールの{合間|あいま}を{縫|ぬ}って、{家族|かぞく}との{時間|じかん}を{作|つく}るようにしている。
examples.english: I try to find time for my family between my hectic schedule.

notes:
USAGE:
More formal and literary than {忙|いそが}しい, which is the everyday word for "busy." {多忙|たぼう} is used in written contexts, formal speech, and when emphasizing an extreme level of busyness.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {忙|いそが}しい: busy (everyday, casual)
- {多忙|たぼう}: very busy (formal, written)
- {繁忙|はんぼう}: extremely busy (formal/business; often in {繁忙期|はんぼうき}, busy season)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多忙|たぼう}を{極|きわ}める: to be extremely busy
- {多忙|たぼう}な{毎日|まいにち}: hectic everyday life
- {多忙|たぼう}なスケジュール: a packed schedule
- {多忙|たぼう}のため: due to being busy
